thread:
SRE-BOT: :rotating_light: Incident detected: inter-region fallback loop between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Health-check flapping observed, 502/error-rate spike across hosted-api route /v1/generate. Autofallback thrashing every 30-60s.

alice.chen: I'm paged and looking. What's the initial impact? Metrics?

raj.patel: APdex down, p50 latency up 450ms, p95 spikes to 2.1s. Errors are 502/503 from model proxy. Graph in #eng-runtime shows repeated failover events at ~10:02:12, 10:02:42, 10:03:15 UTC.

maya.rivera: Confirmed — health checks toggling states between regions, LB routing policy tries fallback to next region, then that region fails back, creating a loop. Likely health-check sensitivity plus aggressive fallback policy.

tom.nguyen: Could be a regression from the recent dynamic-fallback tuning patch (deployed last night). I can roll that back on dedicated. Anyone can pull deploy logs?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T02:14:03Z dynamic-fallback-service v1.4.2 -> v1.4.3 by tom.nguyen. Rollout completed to canary then global.

nora.support: Two customers reported elevated latency and failed requests: internal ticket INC-4632 and INC-4633. Marking P1 for customer-impact.

liam.product: ETA for full rollback? Need to coordinate customer comms if >30m.

alice.chen: First mitigation: disable cross-region auto-fallback policy for hosted API tier (will force traffic to origin region until stable). Applying now.

serena.platform: Command I ran:
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy hosted-api --auto-fallback=false --scope global
```
Response: update accepted. Propagating.

maya.rivera: Also increasing health-check debounce threshold to 5 consecutive failures to avoid flapping.

tom.nguyen: Applying health-check change on edge-probe config:
```
kubectl -n edge-probes patch cm healthchecks --patch '{"interval":10,"failureThreshold":5}'
```

SRE-BOT: Health-check debounce patched. New threshold active in us-east/us-west/eu pools.

raj.patel: Seeing immediate reduction in failover events. Loop count down from 18/min to 0/min over last 45s. Error rate trending down.

alice.chen: Rolling back dynamic-fallback-service to v1.4.2 as a precaution. Triggering a canary first.

deploy-bot: Started rollback canary for dynamic-fallback-service -> v1.4.2. Canary healthy. Rolling global.

nora.support: Customer tickets updated: 'We're investigating intermittent errors and have temporarily adjusted routing to stabilize service.'

liam.product: Good. Prepare short incident summary and customer impact window once stabilized.

tom.nguyen: After rollback + debounce, failovers stopped. But we should add guard: min-ttl for fallback at 90s to avoid oscillation.

maya.rivera: Agree — adding a minimum fallthrough TTL and a circuit-breaker when a region flips more than 3x in 5m.

serena.platform: Proposed config snippet for routing policy:
```
fallback_policy:
  min_ttl: 90
  max_retries: 2
  circuit_breaker:
    flips_threshold: 3
    window_seconds: 300
```

alice.chen: I'm leaving the incident oncall to raj for follow-up. Handoff @raj.patel — please own postmortem and redirect to eng-runtime + platform.

raj.patel: Taking over. I'll coordinate a bug: link to repo and include reproduction steps. Also schedule postmortem meeting.

SRE-BOT: Incident status -> mitigated. Pager cleared.

alice.chen: Thanks team. Timeline: detection 10:01:48 UTC, mitigation started 10:03:00 UTC (routing change), rollback started 10:05:20 UTC, mitigated by 10:07:39 UTC. Total customer-impact window ~6m. Logging notes saved to /incidents/1912345678.

nora.support: Notifying affected customers with timeline and mitigations. Will keep them posted on follow-up.

raj.patel: I'll open the follow-up ticket with action items: revert-safe rollout checks, bump healthcheck defaults, add TTL guard, add alert for flip-rate. Assigning to eng-runtime (maya, tom) and eng-platform (serena).

liam.product: Add mention to status page if any customers ask.

alice.chen: Closing handover. If anything else pops up ping me. :thumbsup:
